# All-Aboard

> Mentor platform for The Hacking Project (THP): Turborepo + pnpm monorepo (Next.js web, Rails-parity API, design system in `packages/ui`), docs in `Docs/` (English, capital D). Agent guide `AGENTS.md` is English; chat with the operator is French.

## Root

- [README.md](README.md): Repository overview and local dev commands
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent guide — Git/CI guards, Hindsight, doc map (English)
- [Docs/README.md](Docs/README.md): Docs entry point
- [Docs/INDEX.md](Docs/INDEX.md): Canonical docs index (English)
